new_defects_found.description: reqwest timeout (5s) fires AFTER status check but BEFORE body parse - can cause synth on invalid 200 OK with empty body
new_defects_found.exploit_or_trigger: Server returns 200 OK with empty body after 4.9s, then timeout fires during json().await
new_defects_found.suggested_fix: Move timeout to be per-request (not per-client) and check elapsed time before json() parse

new_defects_found.description: try_claim_apply_session uses RwLock write lock but fetch_and_reconcile doesn't await it - potential deadlock if T1 and T2 fire simultaneously
new_defects_found.exploit_or_trigger: T1 (reconnect) and T2 (tick) both try to claim same session ID simultaneously
new_defects_found.suggested_fix: Make try_claim_apply_session async and await it in fetch_and_reconcile, or use Mutex instead of RwLock

new_defects_found.description: Synthesized session uses hardcoded zeros instead of cached last_known_stats (C8 finding not fully addressed)
new_defects_found.exploit_or_trigger: Any HTTP synth scenario where driver completed laps - customer sees zeroed summary card
new_defects_found.suggested_fix: Use monitor.session_last_known_stats from FailureMonitorState as specified in design

new_defects_found.description: JSON parse errors log at WARN level but don't distinguish between malformed JSON vs missing fields - obscures schema evolution issues
new_defects_found.exploit_or_trigger: Server adds new field to BillingActiveResponse - all parse errors treated equally
new_defects_found.suggested_fix: Add field-specific error handling and log at different levels

new_defects_found.description: reqwest Client built on every fetch_and_reconcile call - no connection reuse
new_defects_found.exploit_or_trigger: Frequent T2 ticks under high load - increased connection churn
new_defects_found.suggested_fix: Move Client to AppState and reuse across calls

new_defects_found.description: saturating_duration_since on Windows can return negative durations due to non-monotonic clock adjustments
new_defects_found.exploit_or_trigger: System clock adjusted backward during grace window check
new_defects_found.suggested_fix: Use Instant::elapsed() which handles clock adjustments better

new_defects_found.description: stuck_session_candidate flag doesn't verify fallback_version marker presence - will false positive on Part 5 pods
new_defects_found.exploit_or_trigger: Part 5 pod in silent reconnect with active session - incorrectly flagged as stuck
new_defects_found.suggested_fix: Add fallback_version freshness check to compute_stuck_session_candidate

new_defects_found.description: No test coverage for reqwest timeout during json() parse (V-1 scenario)
new_defects_found.exploit_or_trigger: Timeout during parse would cause incorrect synth
new_defects_found.suggested_fix: Add test case with mocked timeout during parse

new_defects_found.description: No test coverage for concurrent apply_session_ended calls (V-2 scenario)
new_defects_found.suggested_fix: Add stress test with concurrent applies

new_defects_found.description: Local session ID snapshot happens before grace window check - race condition with session ID updates
new_defects_found.exploit_or_trigger: Session ID updated between snapshot and grace check
new_defects_found.suggested_fix: Move grace check inside the monitor borrow scope

adversarial_summary: The implementation correctly addresses most Step 1 findings but introduces several new P1/P2 defects that create correctness risks. The most severe issues are: (1) V-1 where reqwest timeout handling can cause incorrect session synthesis from malformed responses, (2) V-2 with potential deadlocks between concurrent session apply attempts, and (3) V-3 where the partial implementation of C8 means customers will see zeroed summary cards. The rollback detection (V-7) is also incomplete and would cause false positives. These issues require fixes before deployment. The test coverage gaps around the new defects are particularly concerning given the concurrency-sensitive nature of the changes.
